messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we agreed to tackle the recurring night-time noise for memcache latency alerts. I sketched an action list, need owners + short timelines.

maya: thanks alex. can we be specific about which alerts? last incident showed a lot of duplicate pages from memcache_high_p99 and memcache_ops_throttle.

sam: yup, those two. also the threshold math on memcache_high_p99 will need per-cluster adjustments. we should avoid a single global number.

jordan: proposal: add dedupe window + route lower-severity duplicates to a logs-only channel for 10pm-6am unless rate > X. reduces paging for low impact flaps.

liam: +1. can we test a 5m dedupe window and a 30m cooldown per host? i think that will cut down repeated pages.

alex: ownership suggestion: sam -> threshold tuning + cluster-specific numbers (ETA 3 business days), jordan -> dedupe policy + routing (ETA 2 business days), maya -> monitoring/metrics to validate (ETA 1 week). liam to implement temporary hush/snooze playbook (ETA today). ok?

maya: works for me. i'll add a small eval dashboard: alerts/day, pagers/hour, uniq-hosts-alerting. will hook it into the shared dashboard.

oncall-bot: Reminder: new oncall playbook change must be approved in #eng-sre. Submit PR to infra/runbooks.

sam: starting thresholds pass now. sample tweak for prod-us-east:
```yaml
- alert: memcache_high_p99
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(memcache_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, cluster)) > 120
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: page
```
I'll push a feature-flagged PR so we can roll back quickly.

jordan: for dedupe/routing, thinking in PagerDuty terms: set dedupe key to host+alertname, then add a filter rule that promotes to page only if open incidents for that host in last 30m == 0. otherwise post as info to #alerts-ops.

liam: temp hush command (run from opsctl):
```
opsctl silence add --alert memcache_high_p99 --duration 4h --reason "postmortem follow-up - night noise" --dry-run
```
I'll run real once sam's PR lands.

alex: metrics to track (maya please):
- total_alerts/day (memcache_* family)
- pagers/day (oncall escalations)
- avg_pages_per_incident
- time_to_ack for night window
Target: reduce night pagers by 75% without increasing missed production incidents.

maya: noted. will attach baseline in the dashboard and send a snapshot tomorrow morning.

alex: quick sync: weekly check-in Friday 09:30 PT to validate. if anyone needs to move timelines, shout here. thanks all :thumbsup:

sam: adding PR link shortly.

jordan: will draft the routing rules and post to #eng-sre for review.

liam: running the hush in dry-run now and will flip after validation.

alex: leaving this thread open for status updates — drop short notes only (no long posts).
